sources.title: Vishva007/Qwen3.5-0.8B-W4A16-AutoRound · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a W4A16 (4-bit weight, 16-bit activation) quantized version of Qwen/Qwen3.5-.8B, produced using AutoRound — Intel's sign gradient descent based quantization method designed for production-grade accuracy retention.

sources.snippet: LightOnOCR-3 is our new family of end-to-end OCR models: text, layout, image and chart understanding from a single compact model.

sources.snippet: LightOnOCR-3-4B Overview LightOnOCR-3-4B is the largest and most accurate model in LightOn's new generation of lightweight, end-to-end OCR models. sources.title: LightOn open-sources LightOnOCR-3 in 0.8B, 1B and 4B sizes under Apache ...
sources.snippet: On ParseBench the 4B scores 75.1, above Infinity Parser Pro's 74.3. At 1540 px, throughput peaks at 4.78 pages/s for the 0.8B and 3.36 pages/s for the 4B; the 1B has the lowest single-page latency at 2.7 s. A new grounding mode returns labeled bounding boxes and image descriptions, and turns chart data into HTML tables.
